data.title: Georgian Bitcoin financier George Bachiashvili sells Miami mansion for record $51.5M; bought incomplete shell for $19M in 2021, listed for $55M and sold in 11 days amid legal saga
data.description: Georgian Bitcoin investor and financier Giorgi “George” Bachiashvili has sold his newly built mansion on Miami Beach’s guard-gated Hibiscus Island for $51.5 million, setting a record for properties on Hibiscus and Palm islands.
